title: Exclude CLI binaries and dev helpers from coverage measurement
description:
Make the coverage metric reflect library code by excluding CLI/campaign binaries and dev/bench/test-support helpers from the `cargo llvm-cov` measurement and the badge inputs.

## Background

CLI entrypoints under `crates/*/src/bin/` (e.g. `sim_runner`, `dvb_t2_awgn_campaign`, `ldpc_bler_sweep`, `generate_ldpc_cache`, `validate_ldpc_cache`, `checkpoint_sweep`, `parallel_throughput`) and dev/bench/test helpers (e.g. `bench_seed.rs`, `testutil.rs`) hold roughly 1470 uncovered lines across the workspace. They are orchestration/argument-parsing glue, not library logic, and conventionally fall outside coverage.

The CI coverage job runs `cargo llvm-cov ... --workspace --json` and feeds the JSON to `scripts/generate-coverage-badges.sh`. Adding an ignore filter at the `llvm-cov` step removes those files from both the workspace total and the per-crate badge denominators in one place.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-1: The CI `cargo llvm-cov` invocation excludes `crates/*/src/bin/**` and the named dev/bench/test-support helpers from the emitted coverage JSON (verified: no such file appears in the report's `files` list).
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-2: Per-crate badge denominators produced by `scripts/generate-coverage-badges.sh` contain no excluded-file lines, so badge percentages reflect library-only coverage.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-3: The exclusion pattern and the rationale for each excluded category are documented in-line where the filter is defined.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-4: gf2-coding and gf2-kernels-simd badges read at or above 90.0% after the change, with no test code modified.

## Notes

Keep the exclusion conservative: CLI binaries and clearly non-library helpers only. Reusable test harnesses that exercise production code (e.g. axiom-test harness) are a judgment call — exclude only if they are test-support rather than library API.
